name: Shenzhen iN-Cube Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen iN-Cube Automation Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor and industrial automation equipment, automation equipment accessories and related technical services in China and internationally. The company offers fully automatic 4-side optical inspection and appearance equipment, LED HSP map sorter, eutectic bonding equipment, IC sorting machine, mini-LED bonding, and PTR panel to reel sorting machine equipment.
